corrections.text: This article stated that "Cloudflare's blog post opens with an internal incident that motivated the project," describing an engineer whose background agents closed thousands of tickets. Cloudflare's blog post introduces this same story with "Let's imagine the Case of the Endlessly Closing Tickets" and later calls it "relatively low-stakes" in contrast to scenarios readers "can all imagine, or read about" - explicitly framing it as an illustrative hypothetical rather than a confirmed, dated internal incident. The article should not have presented it as a verified real event.
